== Biography ==

The Knave of Hearts carries the King's crown upon a crimson velvet cushion during the royal procession. He receives his commands directly from the Queen; when she addresses him, he replies with only a bow and a smile. The Queen dismisses his courtesy harshly, calling him an 'idiot.' The Knave executes her orders with careful precision—when she commands him to 'turn them over,' he complies very carefully, using one foot.

The Knave stands trial for the theft of the Queen's tarts. Before the King, he defends himself by asserting that he did not write the incriminating evidence and that his name is not signed to it. When questioned further, he shakes his head sadly.

== Relationships ==

'''[[King]]''' — employment. The Knave appears to serve the King in a position of ceremonial trust, suggested by his role bearing the royal crown during the procession.

'''[[Queen]]''' — adversary. The Queen's treatment of the Knave suggests opposition: she addresses him dismissively and later initiates his trial for theft, resulting in his imprisonment in chains—establishing their relationship as one where the Knave holds little power.

''Evolution:''
* [[Queen]] — Enemy (ch.8→ch.12)<ref>Alice's Adventures in Wonderland, chapter 8</ref>
